$comment: Record schema documentation for very-deep-search staging rows (one JSON object per line). Enforced by scripts/vds.py validate.

decision.description: Verdict. Only these two values exist.

evidence_ref.description: Workspace-relative path to saved evidence. Mandatory non-empty for pass; the file must exist and be non-empty.

identifier.description: Canonical ID, lowercase-normalized for dedup. Non-empty, no whitespace.

layer1_status.description: Observed locator-resolution status, recorded as-is (int or string).

layer2_match.description: Independent metadata match. Must be a real boolean.

reason.description: Non-empty. Cites the criterion and the observed evidence.

reverify.description: Exact commands reproducing the verification. Mandatory non-empty for pass.

source_url.description: Landing/content URL where the item was found.

tier.description: Content tier. Required for pass rows (enforced by vds.py): A = full text retrieved with a relevance quote; B = metadata-only, with tier-b-block cause in reason.

title: very-deep-search staging record
